subject: Pre-offer clearance: Isabella Turner (Software Infra) — comp & level
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate — Isabella Turner (SWE Infra) — comp guidance for offer

Hi Aditya / Vivek —

Quick summary from onsite: Isabella is a strong infra IC contributor (systems background, shipping infra features, excellent design debrief). Interview panel recommends IC3 (senior engineer) with an early stretch expectation for owning init rollout of service X.

Attached: Isabella_Turner_Resume.pdf, Interview_Notes_Isabella_0908.pdf, Comp_Offer_Scenarios_0908.xlsx

Proposed starter offer (preferred):
- Level: IC3
- Base: $155,000 – $165,000 (target $160k)
- Equity: 0.18% – 0.25% (4 yr, 1 yr cliff)
- Sign-on: $5k – $10k one-time (if needed to bridge counter)

We need internal clearance on level + final band and whether we require an exception for the equity top-end (this will be slightly above baseline for IC3 in the West region). Goal: send offer by Fri 9/11 or Mon 9/14 at latest.

Please reply with: 1) level confirmation, 2) final base/equity numbers, 3) any finance/comp exceptions required.

Thanks — I can push draft to legal once we lock numbers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: Isabella_Turner_Resume.pdf (95KB), Interview_Notes_Isabella_0908.pdf (42KB), Comp_Offer_Scenarios_0908.xlsx (23KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate — Isabella Turner (SWE Infra) — comp guidance for offer

Thanks Marissa — quick thoughts:
- I support IC3. Her design + rollout experience justify leaning toward the higher end of IC3.
- Target base $160k is reasonable.
- For equity, pushing to 0.22% (mid-high) feels fair given ownership scope.

One ask: if we set IC3 and push eq to 0.22–0.25, can comp sign-off confirm there is precedent for that top-end? We don't want to create band creep for future hires.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Eng Manager, Runtime
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Forwarding the candidate packet and manager rec.

Team — can you please review and sign off on the IC3 recommendation and the proposed comp scenario (see attached sheet). Note that manager (Vivek) is asking for 0.22% equity target and $160k base. If comp/finance require a sign-off exception for the equity top-end, highlight the approval path.

I want final clearance by EOD 9/10 so Marissa can get the offer out early next week.

Aditya

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Candidate — Isabella Turner (SWE Infra) — comp guidance for offer

Thanks for the packet — reviewed comps and benchmarks. A few notes:

- Level: IC3 is appropriate given the scope. Approve level.
- Base: $160k OK.
- Equity: 0.22% as a target is acceptable but 0.25% hits the top of our typical IC3 range for West hires. We should mark 0.25% as "exception required."

Recommendation: proceed with offer at 0.22% and a $7,500 sign-on to help close quickly. If the candidate counters and requests 0.25%, we should have a documented exception request with VP/Comp approval and a short rationale (ownership, rare skills). I've started a short justification draft (attached: Comp_justification_Isabella.docx).

Karthik Iyer
Head of Compensation Programs
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: Comp_justification_Isabella.docx (12KB)

On equity: finance is neutral but wants the comp team to document any exception if we go to 0.25%. Approve moving forward with 0.22% equity and the sign-on as recommended. Please route the exception to the VP of Eng for final override if candidate pushes.

I'll add the hire to the headcount tracker and set the budget flag.

Thanks,

Date: 2026-09-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Final approval — Isabella Turner offer clearance

All — thanks for the quick reviews. I have reviewed the packet and the comp justification and approve the hire at:

- Level: IC3
- Base: $160,000
- Equity: 0.22%
- Sign-on: $7,500 one-time

I confirm that 0.22% sits within our acceptable band. If candidate counters to 0.25%, route an exception to me and copy the VP of Eng. I've attached the signed internal approval for records (signed-approval.pdf).

Marissa — you have clearance to proceed with drafting the offer. Please use the standard IC3 template and route to Legal for execution + DocuSign. Let me know when it's sent and share the link.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Talent Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
